candidates.name: St Procopius Parish or community
candidates.reason: The current Orthodox Benelux map names a St Procopius body in Wateringen, but no patriarchal, diocesan, parish or monastery source was found that identifies its jurisdiction, exact institutional name, address or current status. A map may discover an address but cannot be the only evidence that the body exists or establish its canonical parent.

candidates.name: St Barbara Parish
candidates.reason: The current Orthodox Benelux map names a St Barbara parish in Zaandam, but no current patriarchal, diocesan or parish source was found that identifies its canonical parent or confirms it as a separate active body. It is not the Ecumenical Patriarchate's St Catherine parish or the Serbian St Nicholas parish in the same city. Withhold until its parent Church publishes it.

candidates.name: Orthodox Church of Ukraine worship activity in the Netherlands
candidates.reason: Official OCU structures and secondary Netherlands information were checked. They establish visiting clergy and holiday services, but no current official source identifies a permanent Netherlands parish, mission, chapel, monastery, metochion or recurring worship site. Retain until an OCU source publishes a stable body.

candidates.name: UOC worship activity in Wijhe
candidates.claimed_parent: Transfiguration of the Lord Parish in Rotterdam, Ukrainian Orthodox Church
candidates.reason: The parish documents one Divine Liturgy in Wijhe in February 2024 at the invitation of a local Catholic community. Its current schedule does not establish a permanent or recurring Wijhe worship site.

superseded_or_not_current.name: Mother of God Parish at Amersfoort
superseded_or_not_current.reason: Older Netherlands sources call this Antiochian body the Amersfoort parish. The current official Metropolis page names the same parish and clergy at Kerklaan 31 in De Bilt. The current De Bilt row is published without duplicating the moved body.

superseded_or_not_current.name: Holy Myrrhbearers Parish under the Russian Tradition Archdiocese

It is published once under ep-belgium and the stale parallel listing is retained here.

source_reconciliation.subject: Ecumenical Patriarchate coverage
source_reconciliation.result: The official parish pages are not identical. Their union, together with the official March 2026 foundation notice for the Maastricht Holy Girdle parish, establishes seventeen current parishes or communities in the Netherlands.

source_reconciliation.subject: Ecumenical Patriarchate monastery coverage
source_reconciliation.result: The official monastery directory and current Netherlands directory establish three current monasteries under the Archdiocese of Belgium.

source_reconciliation.subject: Serbian Western Europe coverage
source_reconciliation.result: The diocesan overview says there are nine Netherlands worship places, but its summary and detailed page omit different bodies. The official-source union establishes nine parishes. The detailed diocesan page also lists St Anna Chapel under the Breda parish, producing ten directory rows.

source_reconciliation.subject: St Boniface and St Xenia community location
source_reconciliation.result: The current specific English page and deanery index place the community at Metzelaarplein 3 in Deventer. A French index label that places it in The Hague is treated as a directory error, not a second community.

source_reconciliation.subject: Georgian Netherlands coverage
source_reconciliation.result: The dedicated current parish page and current schedules establish Aalsmeer and The Hague parishes. An OKIN governance page saying the Georgian bishop has no Netherlands parishes is contradicted by the site's own dedicated parish directory and current worship evidence. Both parish rows are preserved.

source_reconciliation.subject: Serbian St Demetrius address
source_reconciliation.result: The diocesan page gives Boschdijk 354 in Eindhoven while the current Netherlands directory gives Hornestraat 1 in Helmond. The Netherlands directory's Helmond address and local current listing are used; the body is not duplicated.

source_reconciliation.subject: UOC Rotterdam and Vlaardingen
source_reconciliation.result: The official parish and vicariate sources establish the Rotterdam parish. Its current recurring schedule separately establishes the Hoflaankerk worship site in Vlaardingen as a child row.
